metadata.name: OpenGothic
metadata.summary: Open-source game engine reimplementation of Gothic 2: Night of the Raven

content.value: OpenGothic is an open-source reimplementation of Gothic 2: Night of the Raven designed to run smoothly on modern systems. Utilizing contemporary graphics hardware and APIs like Vulkan, the project provides a feature-complete, faithful game client compatible with original game assets, scripts, and community modifications.

The original game has been thoroughly replicated, allowing players to complete both the main questline and the Night of the Raven expansion. Please note that original Gothic 2: Night of the Raven game data files are required to play.

items.value: Complete replication of the original game, including the main quest and expansion addon
Built for modern graphics pipelines with Vulkan support, mesh shaders, and ray tracing
Compatible with original game data, scripts, and third-party modifications
Automatic detection of common Gothic II installation directories
Cross-platform support across modern Linux, Windows, and macOS operating systems
